live.title: Live updates
live.desc: Push changes and switch status to every open browser without a reload.

monitor.title: Status monitor
monitor.desc: Background LibreNMS poll that detects switches going offline or coming back.

health.title: Health wall and security
health.desc: How often the health plugins (DHCP, DNS, cache, game servers, uplink) and the security plugins are asked.

power.title: Electrics
power.desc: Power boards and circuits: when a circuit counts as loaded, and where its incidents go.

discord.title: Discord alerts
discord.desc: Post to a Discord channel when placed switches go offline or recover.

crew.title: Crew Discord channel
crew.desc: A bot posts each incident with a thread that follows it, and Take it / Fixed buttons for crew whose Discord account is linked. See docs/crew-discord.md.

seats.title: Seat sources
seats.desc: Where the seat to user / IP mapping comes from. Sources are merged in the order listed.

checkin.title: Seat check-in
checkin.desc: A /checkin page where players enter seat and username; their IP and MAC (from LibreNMS ARP) are recorded.

plugin-adguard-home.title: Plugin: AdGuard Home
plugin-adguard-home.desc: Reads AdGuard Home's query log for DNS analytics: what the hall looks up and what AdGuard blocks. Floorbit keeps hall-wide counts only, never who looked up what.

plugin-aruba.title: Plugin: Aruba AOS-CX
plugin-aruba.desc: Live status, ports and traffic of Aruba AOS-CX switches (REST API v10.08), and which switch port an IP is on (ARP, then the MAC tables). Feeds the floor plan, the status monitor, the seat inspector and the check-in page. Only reads: use an operators-group account.

plugin-http-check.title: Plugin: HTTP check
plugin-http-check.desc: Checks that web services (the cache, the ticket shop, a game server's web panel) answer, and shows them on the dashboard and the health wall.

plugin-loki.title: Plugin: Grafana Loki
plugin-loki.desc: Sends the syslog lines Floorbit receives to Grafana Loki, to keep them longer than a day, and searches them with LogQL on the Logs page.

plugin-mikrotik.title: Plugin: MikroTik
plugin-mikrotik.desc: Live status, ports and traffic of MikroTik switches (RouterOS 7 REST API), and which switch port an IP or MAC is on (ARP, then the bridge host tables). Feeds the floor plan, the status monitor, the seat inspector and the check-in page. Only reads: use an account in a read-only group.

plugin-pihole.title: Plugin: Pi-hole
plugin-pihole.desc: Reads Pi-hole's query log (Pi-hole 6 and newer) for DNS analytics: what the hall looks up and what Pi-hole blocks. Floorbit keeps hall-wide counts only, never who looked up what.

plugin-prometheus.title: Plugin: Prometheus
plugin-prometheus.desc: Live switch status and port state, traffic and errors from Prometheus (SNMP exporter, if_mib). Feeds the floor plan, the status monitor and the seat inspector. Prometheus has no ARP or MAC tables, so finding a seat's port by IP still needs LibreNMS or a seat source.

plugin-ssh-ports.title: Plugin: SSH port actions
plugin-ssh-ports.desc: Bounces a seat's switch port, or shuts it for a security finding, over SSH, and runs the saved switch commands. The tech types their own switch login for each action; it is used for that one connection and never stored. Host keys are pinned on first use.

plugin-unifi.title: Plugin: UniFi
plugin-unifi.desc: Live status, ports and traffic of UniFi switches, and which switch port an IP or MAC is on (from the controller's client list). Feeds the floor plan, the status monitor, the seat inspector, the check-in page and the Wi-Fi view (access point load and client counts). Only reads: use a View Only account.

plugin-zabbix.title: Plugin: Zabbix
plugin-zabbix.desc: Live switch status and port state, traffic and errors from Zabbix (hosts with the standard SNMP network interface items). Feeds the floor plan, the status monitor and the seat inspector. Zabbix keeps no ARP or MAC tables, so finding a seat's port by IP still needs LibreNMS, UniFi, MikroTik or a seat source.

plugin-lancache.title: Plugin: LAN cache
plugin-lancache.desc: What the LAN cache served (per service, from disk or the internet), the downloads enough players fetched, lancache-dns lookups, its disk and whether it answers. Read by the local agent in the hall; hall-wide numbers only.

plugin-syslog-relay.title: Plugin: Syslog from the hall
plugin-syslog-relay.desc: The local agent listens for syslog on the event network and sends the lines on over its HTTPS link, to the Logs page and the alerts. Lines wait on the agent's disk while the hosted Floorbit can't be reached.

plugin-telemetry.title: Plugin: Device telemetry
plugin-telemetry.desc: Reads switches and firewalls directly through Telegraf (SNMP, traps, gNMI, Cisco MDT) and the device APIs, and answers like a monitoring tool. Set the devices up under Settings, Telemetry.

plugin-netflow-relay.title: Plugin: Traffic from the hall
plugin-netflow-relay.desc: The local agent collects NetFlow and IPFIX on the event network and sends only the summary the Traffic page shows (hall, area and service totals, per seat volume and mix). The flow records, with addresses and ports, stay on the agent.

plugin-captive-note.title: Plugin: Check-in note on phones
plugin-captive-note.desc: The local agent answers the Captive Portal API on the event network (DHCP option 114), so phones and laptops show a quiet sign-in note until their seat has checked in. Nothing is ever blocked. It keeps answering from the last word while the hosted Floorbit is away.

plugin-front-door.title: Plugin: Front door for attendees
plugin-front-door.desc: The local agent answers on the event network and hands each request on to Floorbit with the address it saw, so check-in finds the seat PC's switch port, the seat speed test measures the hall and each attendee has their own sign-in lockout. Point the check-in address (CHECKIN_ADDRESS) at the agent.

plugin-shelly.title: Plugin: Shelly meters
plugin-shelly.desc: The local agent reads the load from Shelly plugs, relays and energy meters on the event network (first and later generations) and hands it to the circuits on the Electrics page by meter id.

plugin-home-assistant.title: Plugin: Home Assistant meters
plugin-home-assistant.desc: The local agent reads power sensors from a Home Assistant on the event network (watts, kilowatts or amps) and hands them to the circuits on the Electrics page by meter id.

attention.title: Port trouble
attention.desc: Which access ports the Problems page lists as needing a look.

syslog.title: Logs
syslog.desc: Who may send syslog to Floorbit and how much is kept. The listener itself (port, TCP) is set in the environment.

insights.title: DNS, games and bandwidth
insights.desc: How often the DNS and LAN cache logs are read, what is kept, and the bandwidth forecast.

switchtools.title: Switch configs and terminal
switchtools.desc: Nightly config backups and limits for the switch terminal.

backup.title: Backups to S3
backup.desc: Upload a backup to an S3 bucket on a schedule (Amazon S3, MinIO, Garage, Backblaze B2 and others). The backups are listed, restored and downloaded under Backup and restore.

plugin-victorialogs.title: Plugin: VictoriaLogs
plugin-victorialogs.desc: Sends the syslog lines Floorbit receives to VictoriaLogs, to keep them longer than a day, and searches them with LogsQL on the Logs page.

integrations_live_updates_enabled.label: Live updates
integrations_live_updates_enabled.help: Push changes and status updates to open browsers (Server-Sent Events).

integrations_status_monitor_enabled.label: Switch status monitor
integrations_status_monitor_enabled.help: Poll LibreNMS in the background and detect switches going offline or online. Needs LibreNMS.

integrations_status_monitor_interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
integrations_status_monitor_interval.help: How often to ask LibreNMS for device status. Minimum 10.

integrations_status_monitor_confirm.label: Polls to confirm a change
integrations_status_monitor_confirm.help: A new status must be seen this many polls in a row before it counts, to ignore flapping.

integrations_health_interval.label: Check interval (seconds)
integrations_health_interval.help: How often to ask the health plugins. Minimum 10.

integrations_health_confirm.label: Checks to confirm a change
integrations_health_confirm.help: A service must show its new colour this many checks in a row before it alerts.

integrations_security_interval.label: Security check interval (seconds)
integrations_security_interval.help: How often to ask the security plugins for findings. Minimum 15.

integrations_power_enabled.label: Power layer
integrations_power_enabled.help: The Electrics page and the power layer on the floor plan. Turn it off if nobody tracks power.

integrations_power_warn.label: Amber from (% of the fuse rating)
integrations_power_warn.help: A circuit at this load shows amber.

integrations_power_crit.label: Red from (% of the fuse rating)
integrations_power_crit.help: A circuit at this load shows red, files an incident and alerts, before the breaker trips.

integrations_power_voltage.label: Voltage (V)
integrations_power_voltage.help: Turns readings in watts into amps.

integrations_power_interval.label: Meter interval (seconds)
integrations_power_interval.help: How often to ask the power plugins for readings. Minimum 15.

integrations_power_team.label: Electrics team
integrations_power_team.help: The team id power incidents go to. Its members may enter readings and trips.

integrations_power_incidents.label: File power incidents
integrations_power_incidents.help: A circuit turning red or a tripped breaker opens an incident for the Electrics team.

integrations_discord_webhook_url.label: Discord webhook URL
integrations_discord_webhook_url.help: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy URL.

integrations_discord_status_webhook_url.label: Attendee status channel webhook
integrations_discord_status_webhook_url.help: A webhook in a channel attendees read. Every update the crew posts on Network status goes there too, while the public status page is on. Leave empty to post nothing.

integrations_discord_schedule_webhook_ur.label: Attendee programme channel webhook
integrations_discord_schedule_webhook_ur.help: A webhook in a channel attendees read (it can be the status channel's). Shortly before a talk, tournament or meal starts, it is announced there, while the public schedule page is on.

integrations_schedule_announce_minutes.label: Announce the programme (minutes ahead)
integrations_schedule_announce_minutes.help: How long before an item starts it is announced in the programme channel. 0 announces nothing.

integrations_discord_alerts_enabled.label: Discord alerts
integrations_discord_alerts_enabled.help: Post a message when a placed switch goes offline or comes back.

integrations_discord_notify_recovery.label: Notify on recovery
integrations_discord_notify_recovery.help: Also post when a switch comes back online.

integrations_discord_mention.label: Mention on outage
integrations_discord_mention.help: Optional text put in front of outage alerts, e.g. <@&ROLE_ID> or @here.

integrations_discord_username.label: Bot name
integrations_discord_username.help: Name shown on the webhook messages.

integrations_discord_language.label: Language of the messages
integrations_discord_language.help: en (English), de-CH (Swiss German spelling) or de (German for Germany and Austria): alerts, the crew bot and the attendee channels. Slash command answers follow each user's Discord language.

integrations_discord_cooldown.label: Per-switch cooldown (seconds)
integrations_discord_cooldown.help: Do not alert about the same switch more often than this.

integrations_alert_group_after.label: Group switch alerts after
integrations_alert_group_after.help: More switch changes than this in one poll become one message, grouped by power circuit.

integrations_alert_quiet_hours.label: Quiet hours
integrations_alert_quiet_hours.help: e.g. 02:00-08:00 (server time). Messages still go out, but silently and without the mention.

integrations_discord_health_alerts.label: Health wall alerts
integrations_discord_health_alerts.help: Post when a service on the health wall goes red, and when it is back (with Notify on recovery).

integrations_discord_security_alerts.label: Security alerts
integrations_discord_security_alerts.help: Post new high and medium security findings: where (switch, port, seat), never MACs or IPs.

integrations_discord_power_alerts.label: Power alerts
integrations_discord_power_alerts.help: Post when a circuit turns red or its breaker trips, with what it feeds.

integrations_discord_bot_token.label: Bot token
integrations_discord_bot_token.help: Developer Portal → your app → Bot → Reset Token. The bot needs View Channel, Send Messages, Embed Links, Create Public Threads, Send Messages in Threads and Manage Threads in the crew channel.

integrations_discord_crew_channel.label: Crew channel ID
integrations_discord_crew_channel.help: Right-click the channel → Copy Channel ID (turn on Developer Mode first). Incidents get a message and a thread here. Without a webhook URL, alerts go here too.

integrations_discord_app_public_key.label: App public key
integrations_discord_app_public_key.help: Developer Portal → General Information → Public Key. Turns on the Take it and Fixed buttons. Set the Interactions Endpoint URL there to <public URL>/api/discord/interactions.

integrations_discord_crew_enabled.label: Crew channel
integrations_discord_crew_enabled.help: Turn the crew channel off without removing the bot token.

integrations_discord_crew_incidents.label: Incidents in the crew channel
integrations_discord_crew_incidents.help: Post each incident with a thread that follows it until it is fixed.

integrations_discord_crew_notices.label: Crew notices in the crew channel
integrations_discord_crew_notices.help: Post each crew notice a lead puts up, so people away from Floorbit see it too.

integrations_discord_crew_waiting_minute.label: Nudge after (minutes)
integrations_discord_crew_waiting_minute.help: Say once in an incident's thread when nobody has taken it for this long. 0 turns it off.

integrations_discord_crew_unseen_minutes.label: Say a sent job is unseen after (minutes)
integrations_discord_crew_unseen_minutes.help: Say once in an incident's thread when the tech it was sent to hasn't seen it for this long. 0 turns it off.

integrations_discord_crew_waiting_role.label: Role to ping when waiting
integrations_discord_crew_waiting_role.help: Optional. Right-click the role in Server Settings → Roles → Copy Role ID. Its members get pinged by that one line, for example the leads.

integrations_seat_sources.label: Seat sources
integrations_seat_sources.help: Comma-separated, merged in order. Built in: json, http, checkin.

integrations_seat_source_json_path.label: Seat JSON file
integrations_seat_source_json_path.help: Path of the static seat mapping file.

integrations_seat_source_http_token.label: Seat HTTP source token
integrations_seat_source_http_token.help: Sent as a Bearer token, if set.

integrations_seat_source_cache_seconds.label: Seat mapping cache (seconds)
integrations_seat_source_cache_seconds.help: How long a merged mapping is reused before asking the sources again.

integrations_checkin_enabled.label: Seat check-in page
integrations_checkin_enabled.help: Serve /checkin where people enter seat + username; their IP and MAC are recorded. Add "checkin" to Seat sources to use it.

integrations_checkin_address.label: Short check-in address
integrations_checkin_address.help: A name people can type on their PC, e.g. checkin.lan: point it at Floorbit in the event DNS. It goes on the seat cards and the sign-in page, and opening it lands on /checkin.

integrations_checkin_require_pin.label: Always ask for the seat PIN
integrations_checkin_require_pin.help: Each seat card shows a 5-character PIN; on a PC people type the PIN and their nick, and the PIN names the seat. When on, typing a seat number without its PIN is refused too.

integrations_checkin_allowed_networks.label: Allowed networks
integrations_checkin_allowed_networks.help: Comma-separated CIDRs players check in from, e.g. 10.0.0.0/16. Empty allows any.

integrations_checkin_trust_proxy.label: Behind a reverse proxy
integrations_checkin_trust_proxy.help: Use X-Forwarded-For as the client IP for per-client limits and the sign-in lockout. Check-in takes the PC's address only from the local agent's front door. Only turn on if a proxy you control sets it.

integrations_checkin_proxy_hops.label: Proxies in front
integrations_checkin_proxy_hops.help: How many proxies you control add to X-Forwarded-For (e.g. 2 for a CDN in front of the ingress). Only used behind a reverse proxy.

integrations_checkin_validate_seats.label: Only accept seats on the plan
integrations_checkin_validate_seats.help: Reject seat numbers that are not in any seat block.

integrations_captive_enabled.label: Captive portal (DHCP option 114)
integrations_captive_enabled.help: Tell the local agent which machines checked in, so phones and laptops that did not see a quiet "sign in to network" note that opens the check-in page. Needs the check-in page, the plugin "Check-in note on phones" and option 114 in the event DHCP. Nothing is ever blocked.

integrations_seat_walk_agent_url.label: Local agent address for the seat walk-through
integrations_seat_walk_agent_url.help: Where laptops in the hall reach the local agent's captive port, e.g. http://192.0.2.10:8908. Empty: the address the agent reports (FLOORBIT_AGENT_LAN_URL).

integrations_checkin_verify_rate.label: Port lookups per second
integrations_checkin_verify_rate.help: How many check-ins a second the background looks up in the monitoring source. A burst of check-ins waits its turn instead of flooding LibreNMS.

integrations_checkin_refresh_interval.label: Lease refresh (seconds)
integrations_checkin_refresh_interval.help: How often to re-check each MAC in LibreNMS and follow DHCP IP changes.

integrations_checkin_admin_token.label: Admin token
integrations_checkin_admin_token.help: If set, listing or deleting check-ins needs this token (X-Admin-Token header).

integrations_checkin_history_enabled.label: Keep check-in history
integrations_checkin_history_enabled.help: Log every check-in, seat move, removal and DHCP IP change, for /checkins/history and CSV export.

integrations_checkin_history_file.label: Check-in history file
integrations_checkin_history_file.help: Append-only JSON Lines log. Empty means next to the check-in data file (checkins-history.jsonl).

integrations_inventory_sync_minutes.label: Inventory sync (minutes)
integrations_inventory_sync_minutes.help: How often the inventory plugins (NetBox) are synced on their own, 5 or more. 0 is off: only Sync now.

integrations_public_url.label: Public URL
integrations_public_url.help: Where people open the floor plan; used for links in alerts.

integrations_qr_url.label: Address on the seat QR codes
integrations_qr_url.help: Where the QR codes on the seat cards point, e.g. http://help.lan when attendees reach Floorbit under another name than the crew. Empty uses the public URL. Reprint the cards after a change.

plugin_adguard-home_url.label: AdGuard Home URL
plugin_adguard-home_url.help: The address of AdGuard Home's web interface. The query log must be on (Settings > General settings).

plugin_aruba_switches.label: Switches
plugin_aruba_switches.help: Comma-separated, each as Name=URL, for example sw-a-01=https://192.0.2.31. The name must match the floor plan. Add the core too, so IPs can be found in its ARP table.

plugin_aruba_username.label: Username
plugin_aruba_username.help: A local account in the operators group (read-only).

plugin_aruba_vlans.label: Player VLANs
plugin_aruba_vlans.help: Comma-separated VLAN IDs to search for a player's MAC, like 100,101. Empty: every VLAN on the switch.

plugin_aruba_timeout.label: Timeout
plugin_aruba_timeout.help: Seconds to wait for each switch.

plugin_aruba_verify_ssl.label: Verify TLS certificates
plugin_aruba_verify_ssl.help: Switches ship with a self-signed certificate. Turn this off only on a network you trust.

plugin_http-check_targets.label: Services
plugin_http-check_targets.help: Comma-separated, each as Name=URL, for example Cache=https://cache.example.com/health. A URL alone is named by its host.

plugin_http-check_timeout.label: Timeout
plugin_http-check_timeout.help: Seconds to wait for each service.

plugin_loki_tenant.label: Tenant
plugin_loki_tenant.help: Sent as X-Scope-OrgID when Loki runs with several tenants. Leave empty otherwise.

plugin_loki_username.label: Username
plugin_loki_username.help: For Loki behind basic auth, or Grafana Cloud's user id.

plugin_loki_event_label.label: Event label
plugin_loki_event_label.help: Added to every line as event=..., to tell events apart in one Loki.

plugin_mikrotik_switches.label: Switches
plugin_mikrotik_switches.help: Comma-separated, each as Name=URL, for example sw-a-01=https://192.0.2.21. The name must match the floor plan. Add the router too, so IPs can be found in its ARP table.

plugin_mikrotik_username.label: Username
plugin_mikrotik_username.help: An account in a group with read and api (or rest-api) rights only.

plugin_mikrotik_timeout.label: Timeout
plugin_mikrotik_timeout.help: Seconds to wait for each device.

plugin_mikrotik_verify_ssl.label: Verify TLS certificates
plugin_mikrotik_verify_ssl.help: RouterOS's www-ssl service needs a certificate. Turn this off only for self-signed ones on a network you trust.

plugin_pihole_url.label: Pi-hole URL
plugin_pihole_url.help: The address of Pi-hole's web interface, without /admin.

plugin_pihole_password.label: App password
plugin_pihole_password.help: Settings > Web interface / API > Configure app password. The web password works too.

plugin_prometheus_url.label: Prometheus URL
plugin_prometheus_url.help: The Prometheus server (or anything that speaks its query API, like Thanos or VictoriaMetrics).

plugin_prometheus_token.label: Bearer token
plugin_prometheus_token.help: Only if Prometheus sits behind a proxy that wants one.

plugin_prometheus_job.label: Job
plugin_prometheus_job.help: The scrape job of the SNMP exporter. Only its series are read.

plugin_prometheus_device_label.label: Switch name label
plugin_prometheus_device_label.help: The label that holds the switch's name, to match it to the floor plan (instance, sysName, ...).

plugin_prometheus_rate_window.label: Rate window
plugin_prometheus_rate_window.help: How far back traffic rates look, like 2m. At least twice the scrape interval.

plugin_ssh-ports_platform.label: Switch software
plugin_ssh-ports_platform.help: Which commands take a port down and up again. Custom uses the two lists below.

plugin_ssh-ports_down_seconds.label: Seconds down
plugin_ssh-ports_down_seconds.help: How long the port stays down before it is turned on again.

plugin_ssh-ports_timeout.label: Timeout
plugin_ssh-ports_timeout.help: Seconds to wait for the switch.

plugin_ssh-ports_trust_new_hosts.label: Trust a switch's key the first time
plugin_ssh-ports_trust_new_hosts.help: Pins each switch's SSH host key on the first connection and refuses the switch if it changes. Off: only switches whose key is already pinned are used.

plugin_ssh-ports_custom_down.label: Custom commands to take a port down
plugin_ssh-ports_custom_down.help: Comma-separated, {port} is the interface. Only for Custom.

plugin_ssh-ports_custom_up.label: Custom commands to bring it back
plugin_ssh-ports_custom_up.help: Comma-separated, {port} is the interface. Only for Custom.

plugin_unifi_url.label: Controller URL
plugin_unifi_url.help: The UniFi console (UniFi OS) or the Network application. No path.

plugin_unifi_unifi_os.label: UniFi OS console
plugin_unifi_unifi_os.help: On for a Dream Machine, Cloud Key Gen2 or UniFi OS server. Off for the older Network application on port 8443.

plugin_unifi_username.label: Username
plugin_unifi_username.help: A local account with the View Only role.

plugin_unifi_site.label: Site
plugin_unifi_site.help: The site's short name (from the URL in the controller: /manage/<site>/...).

plugin_unifi_verify_ssl.label: Verify TLS certificates
plugin_unifi_verify_ssl.help: Consoles ship with a self-signed certificate. Turn it off only on a network you trust.

plugin_zabbix_url.label: Zabbix URL
plugin_zabbix_url.help: The Zabbix front end. Floorbit calls its api_jsonrpc.php (Zabbix 6.4 or newer).

plugin_zabbix_token.label: API token
plugin_zabbix_token.help: Administration > Users > API tokens, for a user whose role can only read the switches' host group.

plugin_zabbix_group.label: Host group
plugin_zabbix_group.help: Only hosts in this group are read.

plugin_lancache_access_log.label: Access log
plugin_lancache_access_log.help: The cache's access.log as the agent sees it (mount the cache's logs folder read-only into the agent).

plugin_lancache_dns_log.label: DNS query log
plugin_lancache_dns_log.help: lancache-dns's query log (bind with querylog on), as the agent sees it. Empty: no DNS numbers.

plugin_lancache_cache_dir.label: Cache folder
plugin_lancache_cache_dir.help: The folder with nginx's hash folders (00 to ff), as the agent sees it: for the disk use, and for clearing the cache (then mounted writable).

plugin_lancache_cache_host.label: Cache address
plugin_lancache_cache_host.help: Name or address of the cache on the event network, for the heartbeat check.

plugin_lancache_dns_server.label: lancache-dns address
plugin_lancache_dns_server.help: Checks that it sends the cached services to the cache. Needs the cache address.

plugin_lancache_min_clients.label: Players before a download or site is named

plugin_syslog-relay_port.label: UDP port on the agent
plugin_syslog-relay_port.help: Where the switches and firewalls send syslog, on the agent machine (514 is the usual one; the agent needs the right to use it). 0: off.

plugin_syslog-relay_bind.label: Listen address
plugin_syslog-relay_bind.help: The agent's address to listen on. Empty: all of them.

plugin_telemetry_uplink_macs.label: Uplink MAC limit
plugin_telemetry_uplink_macs.help: A port that sees more MAC addresses than this counts as an uplink and is skipped when Floorbit looks for where a seat is plugged in.

plugin_telemetry_exclude.label: Ports to ignore
plugin_telemetry_exclude.help: Parts of port names that are never a seat's port (trunks, port channels, SVIs), separated by commas.

plugin_netflow-relay_port.label: UDP port on the agent
plugin_netflow-relay_port.help: Where the switches and routers export NetFlow or IPFIX to, on the agent machine (2055 is usual). 0: off.

plugin_netflow-relay_bind.label: Listen address
plugin_netflow-relay_bind.help: The agent's address to listen on. Empty: all of them.

plugin_captive-note_address.label: Address on the agent
plugin_captive-note_address.help: host:port the agent answers on. Serve it behind the event's reverse proxy with a certificate: RFC 8908 wants HTTPS. Empty: off.

plugin_captive-note_portal_url.label: Sign-in page
plugin_captive-note_portal_url.help: Where the note leads. Empty: the check-in page the hosted Floorbit names.

plugin_captive-note_proxies.label: Reverse proxy addresses
plugin_captive-note_proxies.help: Comma-separated. From these, the client's address is taken from X-Forwarded-For.

plugin_front-door_address.label: Address on the agent
plugin_front-door_address.help: host:port the agent answers on. HTTPS when the agent has a certificate (FLOORBIT_AGENT_TLS_CERT and _KEY on the agent). Empty: off.

plugin_front-door_proxies.label: Reverse proxy addresses
plugin_front-door_proxies.help: Comma-separated. From these, the seat PC's address is taken from X-Forwarded-For.

plugin_shelly_devices.label: Meters
plugin_shelly_devices.help: One per line: the circuit's meter id = the Shelly's address, and optionally which channel (switch:0, pm1:0, em:0, em1:1 or a number on the first generation). Without a channel, all its channels added up.

plugin_shelly_username.label: Username
plugin_shelly_username.help: Only when the Shellys have a password (later generations always use admin).

plugin_shelly_password.label: Password
plugin_shelly_password.help: The same for all of them. A Shelly that refuses it is not asked again until a tech clears it on Local agents, or the password here changes.

plugin_home-assistant_token.label: Access token
plugin_home-assistant_token.help: A long-lived access token (your profile in Home Assistant, Security). Read access is enough. If Home Assistant refuses it, it is not tried again until a tech clears it on Local agents, or the token here changes.

plugin_home-assistant_sensors.label: Sensors
plugin_home-assistant_sensors.help: One per line: the circuit's meter id = the sensor's entity id. Its unit decides: W, kW or A.

integrations_attention_interval.label: Port read (seconds)
integrations_attention_interval.help: How often every access port is read for port trouble: flapping, errors rising, half duplex. Minimum 30.

integrations_attention_flaps.label: Link changes that count as flapping
integrations_attention_flaps.help: This many link ups and downs within 10 minutes put a port on the list.

integrations_attention_errors.label: Errors per read
integrations_attention_errors.help: A port whose error counter rises by this much between two reads is listed.

integrations_syslog_allow.label: Allowed senders
integrations_syslog_allow.help: Comma-separated addresses or CIDRs that may send syslog, besides the switches on the plan. Empty: only the switches.

integrations_syslog_allow_switches.label: Accept the switches on the plan
integrations_syslog_allow_switches.help: Lines from the management address of every switch in the inventory are accepted.

integrations_syslog_rate.label: Lines per second per sender
integrations_syslog_rate.help: More from one sender in a second are dropped and counted, so one chatty box can't flood the page.

integrations_syslog_retention_hours.label: Keep lines (hours)
integrations_syslog_retention_hours.help: How long log lines are kept for the Logs page.

integrations_syslog_max_lines.label: Lines kept at most
integrations_syslog_max_lines.help: Older lines go first when there are more.

integrations_syslog_max_mb.label: Log size at most (MB)
integrations_syslog_max_mb.help: The stored log is cut back to this size.

integrations_log_alert_minutes.label: Repeat a log alert after (minutes)
integrations_log_alert_minutes.help: The same log alert on the same box is sent again only after this long.

integrations_dns_interval.label: DNS log read (seconds)
integrations_dns_interval.help: How often the DNS plugins' query logs are read.

integrations_dns_min_seats.label: Seats before a domain is named
integrations_dns_min_seats.help: A domain shows on the DNS page only once this many different clients looked it up, so nobody can be singled out. 5 at least.

integrations_dns_retention_hours.label: Keep DNS counts (hours)
integrations_dns_retention_hours.help: How long the hall-wide DNS counts are kept.

integrations_lancache_interval.label: LAN cache log read (seconds)
integrations_lancache_interval.help: How often the LAN cache's access log is read for the Games page.

integrations_lancache_retention_hours.label: Keep LAN cache counts (hours)
integrations_lancache_retention_hours.help: How long downloads per game are kept.

integrations_stats_uplink_pattern.label: Uplink port names
integrations_stats_uplink_pattern.help: A regular expression for port descriptions that mark uplinks, for the bandwidth figures. Empty: uplink or trunk.

integrations_forecast_capacity_mbps.label: Internet line (Mbit/s)
integrations_forecast_capacity_mbps.help: The event's internet bandwidth, for the forecast. 0 turns the forecast warning off.

integrations_forecast_warn_percent.label: Warn at (% of the line)
integrations_forecast_warn_percent.help: Warn when the forecast reaches this share of the line.

integrations_forecast_lead_hours.label: Look ahead (hours)
integrations_forecast_lead_hours.help: How far ahead the forecast warns.

integrations_discord_forecast_alerts.label: Post forecast warnings
integrations_discord_forecast_alerts.help: Post to Discord when the bandwidth forecast expects the line to fill up.

integrations_game_interval.label: Game server query (seconds)
integrations_game_interval.help: How often each game server is asked for players and map.

integrations_services_interval.label: Service check (seconds)
integrations_services_interval.help: How often DNS, DHCP and the other services are checked.

integrations_config_backup_hour.label: Nightly config backup (hour)
integrations_config_backup_hour.help: The hour (0-23) the switch configs are saved each night, or off.

integrations_terminal_idle_minutes.label: Close an idle terminal after (minutes)
integrations_terminal_idle_minutes.help: A switch terminal with no typing for this long is closed.

integrations_terminal_max_minutes.label: Longest terminal session (minutes)
integrations_terminal_max_minutes.help: A switch terminal is closed after this long in any case.

integrations_checkin_pin_tries.label: Wrong PINs before a pause
integrations_checkin_pin_tries.help: After this many wrong PINs from one address, check-in pauses for it.

integrations_seat_source_http_verify_ssl.label: Verify the HTTP source's TLS certificate
integrations_seat_source_http_verify_ssl.help: Turn off only for a source with a self-signed certificate on the event network.

integrations_s3_backup_endpoint.label: S3 endpoint
integrations_s3_backup_endpoint.help: The S3 address of MinIO, Garage, Backblaze B2 or another store, like https://s3.example.com. Empty: Amazon S3.

integrations_s3_backup_region.label: Region
integrations_s3_backup_region.help: The bucket's region, like eu-central-1. Most other stores take us-east-1.

integrations_s3_backup_prefix.label: Folder in the bucket
integrations_s3_backup_prefix.help: Backups go here. Only files Floorbit made here are listed and deleted.

integrations_s3_backup_access_key.label: Access key ID
integrations_s3_backup_access_key.help: Give the key only list, read, write and delete in this bucket.

integrations_s3_backup_secret_key.label: Secret access key
integrations_s3_backup_secret_key.help: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

integrations_s3_backup_passphrase.label: Encryption passphrase
integrations_s3_backup_passphrase.help: Set it to encrypt each backup before it leaves, so the bucket only holds what nobody can read. Keep a copy elsewhere: without it, encrypted backups cannot be restored.

integrations_s3_backup_interval_hours.label: Back up every (hours)
integrations_s3_backup_interval_hours.help: 0: only when someone presses Back up now.

integrations_s3_backup_keep.label: Backups kept
integrations_s3_backup_keep.help: After each upload, older backups in the folder are deleted.

plugin_victorialogs_account.label: Tenant
plugin_victorialogs_account.help: AccountID:ProjectID when VictoriaLogs keeps several tenants. Leave empty otherwise.

plugin_victorialogs_username.label: Username
plugin_victorialogs_username.help: For VictoriaLogs behind basic auth (vmauth or a proxy).

plugin_victorialogs_event_label.label: Event label
plugin_victorialogs_event_label.help: Added to every line as event=..., to tell events apart in one VictoriaLogs.

plugins.librenms: Live switch status, port details and traffic, and which switch port an IP or MAC is on (ARP and MAC tables). Feeds the floor plan, the seat heatmap, the status monitor and the check-in page.
plugins.netbox: Adds the devices with the configured roles from NetBox to the inventory (name, role, model, serial, management IP, site and status). Fields changed by hand in Floorbit stay as they are.
plugins.demo: A made-up hall: switches, seat blocks, players on documentation IPs, ports going up and down and traffic that moves. Nothing real: example names, 192.0.2.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24. While it's on it replaces the live monitoring source and fills the health wall.
plugins.lancache: What the LAN cache served (per service, from disk or the internet), the downloads enough players fetched, lancache-dns lookups, its disk and whether it answers. Read by the local agent in the hall; hall-wide numbers only.
plugins.syslog-relay: The local agent listens for syslog on the event network and sends the lines on over its HTTPS link, to the Logs page and the alerts. Lines wait on the agent's disk while the hosted Floorbit can't be reached.
plugins.netflow-relay: The local agent collects NetFlow and IPFIX on the event network and sends only the summary the Traffic page shows (hall, area and service totals, per seat volume and mix). The flow records, with addresses and ports, stay on the agent.
plugins.captive-note: The local agent answers the Captive Portal API on the event network (DHCP option 114), so phones and laptops show a quiet sign-in note until their seat has checked in. Nothing is ever blocked. It keeps answering from the last word while the hosted Floorbit is away.
plugins.front-door: The local agent answers on the event network and hands each request on to Floorbit with the address it saw, so check-in finds the seat PC's switch port, the seat speed test measures the hall and each attendee has their own sign-in lockout. Point the check-in address (CHECKIN_ADDRESS) at the agent.
plugins.shelly: The local agent reads the load from Shelly plugs, relays and energy meters on the event network (first and later generations) and hands it to the circuits on the Electrics page by meter id.
plugins.home-assistant: The local agent reads power sensors from a Home Assistant on the event network (watts, kilowatts or amps) and hands them to the circuits on the Electrics page by meter id.
